description: This source file implements a serializer (codec) for the .NET type DateTimeOffset within the Orleans serialization framework. It provides methods to write and read DateTimeOffset objects to and from a wire protocol, handling field headers and sub-fields (DateTime and Offset).

classes.name: DateTimeOffsetCodec
classes.description: A sealed class implementing IFieldCodec for DateTimeOffset, responsible for serializing and deserializing DateTimeOffset instances.

methods.name: WriteField(ref Writer<TBufferWriter> writer, uint fieldIdDelta, DateTimeOffset value)
methods.description: Serializes a DateTimeOffset object into the buffer with type info.

methods.name: WriteField<TBufferWriter>(ref Writer<TBufferWriter> writer, uint fieldIdDelta, DateTimeOffset value) where TBufferWriter : IBufferWriter<byte>
methods.description: Serializes a DateTimeOffset object into the buffer without type info, assuming expected type is known.

methods.name: ReadValue<TInput>(ref Reader<TInput> reader, Field field)
methods.description: Deserializes a DateTimeOffset object from the buffer, given a field.
